facts.text: The client bought a laptop online for personal use for Rs. 78,999.
The laptop was delivered on 3 August 2026.
The laptop began shutting down repeatedly from 7 August 2026.
An authorised service centre recorded a motherboard fault.
The client requested a replacement from the seller.
The seller refused replacement and offered only repair.
The return policy promises replacement for eligible manufacturing defects.
The laptop was purchased for the client's personal use.
